item.title: Shabbat Shalom and Chag Sameach!
item.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat and the the holidays of Shmini Atzeret and Simchat Torah in North America, where they are being written now.
Updates will resume Saturday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat, Shmini Atzeret and Simchat Torah at 18:58 Jerusalem time.

item.title: Israelis set to interrogate Flydubai pilot
item.description: The Flydubai pilot was transferred yesterday to the United Arab Emirates, where he is expected to be interrogated by Israeli officials.

item.title: Rescue flight departs for Dubai
item.description: A special flight has departed Israel to repatriate Israelis who were stranded in Dubai by flight cancellations following the Flydubai incident.

item.title: Amb. Huckabee honors Flydubai heroes
item.description:
US ambassador Mike Huckabee tweeted on Friday that he had met with the ISraelis who helped subdue the Flydubai terrorist.
"Israeli plumber who heroically subdued terrorist & grabbed the controls of plane came to the US embassy in Jerusalem," Huckabee wrote. "I gave him my autographed hat from President Trump. Yaniv & Meital Hayoun inspired the world. He loves Donald Trump & I'll post his message to the President later. What a story!"

item.title: Flydubai doctor says prayer of thanks
item.description: Dr. Shota Musaev, who helped the pilot during the Flydubai incident, recited the traditional Hagomel blessing after being delivered from danger.

item.title: Francesca Albanese, UN Rapporteur, becomes a laughingstock
item.description: The rabid Jew-hater actually mixed up the words, “Muselmann" and "Muslim". Can she be the UN’s least literate antisemite? Opinion.

item.title: Netanyahu: 'Whoever sent the Flydubai terrorist will pay a steep price'
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu commented on the interrogation of the Flydubai pilot. "As time goes by, the picture is becoming clearer. The terrorist has undergone Islamic radicalization. He came to crash the plane with its passengers. We are investigating whether he was sent, and whoever sent him will pay a very heavy price."

item.title: Amb. Yechiel Leiter: 'Until we defeat the ideology of killing, we are on life support'
item.description: Israel’s Ambassador to the United States Yechiel Leiter wrote an emotional message from the bedside of his critically wounded son, Neriyah, ahead of the Simchat Torah holiday.

item.title: The ultimate validation of Zionism
item.description: The willingness, nay, the insistence on taking responsibility for oneself and for the Jewish People is the epitome of the Zionist dream. Opinion.

item.title: The dance that was interrupted
item.description: Three years ago, on Simchat Torah, Jewish dances were violently interrupted by the savages of Hamas. Some of those who danced before October 7 will never dance with us again.

item.title: IDF and Shin Bet eliminate Hamas sniper in Khan Yunis
item.description:
The IDF and Shin Bet struck in the Khan Yunis area on Thursday, eliminating the terrorist Tamer Hamaida, who served as a sniper in the Hamas terrorist organization.
Throughout the war, the terrorist advanced terror and sniper attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians and worked to restore the terrorist organization’s capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorist was eliminated in an aerial strike.

item.title: Trumpets sound again in Jericho as worshipers pray at ancient synagogue
item.description: Rabbi Yossi Palai and fellow worshipers sounded trumpets during Friday morning prayers at Jericho’s ancient Shalom al Yisrael Synagogue.

item.title: UAE President advisor: Hijacking a terrorist act, Indian pilot deserves every bit of appreciation
item.description:
Anwar Gargash, the senior diplomatic advisor to the United Arab Emirates president, praised Indian Flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar, who was stabbed by his terrorist co-pilot, saying he "deserves every bit of appreciation, for he embodied the meaning of courage and responsibility in the face of a dangerous terrorist act and a potential disaster."
Gargash said the pilot's "professionalism and moral sense in the darkest of circumstances make him a true hero."
He added: "Far from the easy reduction of what happened or the adoption and promotion of conspiracy theories, vigilance and caution remain essential in confronting the risks of extremism and terrorism."

item.title: Supreme Court overturns election bans on Cassif, Joint List, and Ra'am
item.description: In a series of rulings ahead of the 26th Knesset elections, the Supreme Court allows MK Ofer Cassif, the Joint List, and Ra'am to run, while proceedings against Sami Abu Shehadeh were dropped after he withdrew his candidacy.

item.title: We don’t protect the mitzvot. The mitzvot protect us
item.description: As Klal Yisrael shook the lulav and etrog in every direction, a miracle unfolded in the sky. But we do not need to wait for a miracle in the sky to value what Hashem placed in our hands, yet when He allows us to see one so openly, we should open our eyes, recognize it and say thank You.
